description: Find up to three ready-made multi-agent workflows (necklaces) for a purpose, by capability or common aliases. Discovery does not execute it. Use when a multi-step published workflow may already do your task. Example arguments: {"task": "country population indicators"} Ads: one "Advertisement" in a separate `sponsored` array, also in `_meta["biz.agentconcierge/sponsored"]` and a last "Advertisement:" text line; results unchanged.

protocol.description: Optional explicit constraint on workflow node protocols.

task.description: The outcome you need, in plain language.

visitor_token.description: Your visitor token (vt_…) so I remember you. Omit on first contact.

name: search_workflows

outputSchema.description: Fields vary by operation; check isError and status first.

direct_only.description: Not run by this gateway; not a recommendation.

sponsored.description: One labelled Advertisement, apart from the results; `disclosure` says paid or house. It does not affect ranking, selection or test results.

visitor.description: Session transport only; never put it in answer text.

title: Browse published workflows
